The [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] contained a single '''sea'''. The [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] was located in the polar regions of the planet and was rimmed in [[Water/Legends|ice]]. All of the other large bodies of water on the planet were classified as lakes.<ref name="CatCW" />
